# OPRO

> > OPRO is the official mouthguard provider for UFC, USA Wrestling, and major international sports organizations, offering custom-fit protection across multiple contact sports.

OPRO manufactures premium mouthguards trusted by over 10 million athletes worldwide. The company specializes in custom-fit technology with multiple protection levels (Gold, Silver, Bronze) and instant-fit options, serving boxers, rugby players, hockey athletes, MMA fighters, and martial artists.

- Custom-Fit Mouthguards

- Snap-Fit Mouthguards
- UFC Official Partner
- Rugby Protection

- Dental Warranty
- Multi-Sport Protection
- Youth & Adult Sizing
